message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1‑9, two Skip, two Reverse, two Draw Two) + 4 Wild + 4 Wild Draw Four. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points over multiple rounds. Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players play clockwise; Reverse changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise the turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and skips a turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **UNO Call** | When you have one card left you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands (number cards = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50). | | **Scoring** | Add round points to the winner’s total. First player to reach 500 points wins the game. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | If a Draw Two or Wild Draw Four is played, the next player may stack another of the same type instead of drawing. | | **Seven-O** | Playing a 7 lets you swap hands with any player; playing a 0 forces all players to rotate hands clockwise. | | **Jump-In** | If you have an exact duplicate of the top discard, you may play it immediately, even out of turn. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack, Uno Spin) for different mechanics. | **Common Misconceptions** | Misconception | Clarification | |---------------|---------------| | “You can play any card after drawing.” | You may only play the drawn card if it matches; you cannot play other cards from your hand. | | “Wild Draw Four can be played anytime.” | It can only be played if you have no card of the current color. | | “UNO call is optional.” | It’s mandatory; failing to call results in a penalty. | **Strategy Tips** | Tip | Why it helps | |-----|--------------| | Keep a balanced mix of colors | Reduces the chance of being stuck with a single color. | | Hold onto action cards | They’re powerful when used strategically. | | Watch opponents’ hands | Helps anticipate when they might be close to winning. | | Use Wild cards wisely | Choose colors that benefit you and disadvantage opponents. | **Common Questions** | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | *Can I play a Wild card on a Wild Draw Four?* | Yes, but you must still follow the color rule if you have a matching color. | | *What happens if the draw pile runs out?* | Shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | *Is there a limit to how many cards you can hold?* | No, you can hold as many cards as you want. | Feel free to ask if you’d like deeper explanations on any rule or strategy!
